text:
sam_pm: proposing SLA-prioritized rollout for quant-defaults + routing. goal: cost wins while keeping contracted customers unchanged. need ops & CS sign-off.

sam_pm: high level -> shadow (0%) -> deterministic tenant-canaries (top-10 + 3 small) -> tiered slices (respect gold/silver/bronze) -> broad/global.

anya_sre: agree. require per-tenant circuit-breaker `cb:tenant:{id}` and per-region kill switch. auto-rollback if p95 > baseline +30ms or error-rate +0.2pp.

mike_research: adding quality checks: session-coherence metric and token-level divergence. fail if session-coherence drops >0.10. will provide baseline by tenant tier.

tara_cs: need opt-out in tenant admin and CS console. for enterprise, default exempt. log opt-out reason to billing notes.

li_engineering: flag model: keys `quant4_stage`, `quant4_exempt`, `quant4_rollout_id`. stages: [shadow, tenant-canary, tier-slice, broad, global]. store rollout metadata in rollout-service.

notify-bot: Created ticket ROLL-5901 and pipeline run id canary-5901.

anya_sre: test plan: simulate region p95 spike, tenant isolation test, and cache-thrash. add a staging chaos that flips region kill-switch mid-run.

mike_research: for deterministic sampling, we'll use `canary_seed` and pick tenants reproducibly. first canary window = 2h focused sampling.

li_engineering: telemetry feeds: latency p50/p95/p99, errors, cost-per-token delta, cache-hit-rate, session-coherence. expose `rollout-{id}` dashboard.

tara_cs: I'll draft customer advisory and the opt-out flow steps. sales wants a heads-up email before tier-slice.

sam_pm: next actions: li to PR flag schema by Thu, mike to deliver eval baselines by Mon, anya to add chaos tests by Wed, tara to prep comms. aiming to start shadow next week. :thumbsup:
